locationComparison.name: Deep Wilderness Dungeon
notes: Wilderness hill giants for Krystilia: the Deep Wilderness Dungeon (~level 50), plus the Boneyard Hunter area and Lava Maze at lower Wilderness levels.
Deep Wilderness Dungeon is single-way, cannonable and safespottable per the wiki; the Lava Maze spawns are also cannonable and the Boneyard Hunter area is multicombat.

taskNotes: Hill giants can be assigned by Krystilia (75-125, Wilderness only) and Mazchna (30-50, combat level 25 required).
Hill giants are combat level 28 with 35 Hitpoints and 26 Defence; they attack with crush and are aggressive to players below combat level 57.
They are 25% susceptible to earth spells; their low Defence means any combat style is effective.
Krystilia's assignment must be completed in the Wilderness (Deep Wilderness Dungeon, Boneyard Hunter area, or Lava Maze).
Mazchna's assignment can be completed anywhere; the free-to-play Edgeville Dungeon is the most convenient spot.
Hill giants always drop big bones and drop a limpwurt root commonly, and are a source of the Giant key for the Obor boss.
The slayerTargetId 260 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract, worklist §1); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
recommendedMethod: Any combat style works given their low Defence. Melee them with a decent weapon such as a Dragon scimitar, or safespot/cannon where allowed. Krystilia tasks must be killed in the Wilderness; Mazchna tasks are most convenient at the Edgeville Dungeon.
